spans.s:
ग॑णक m. arithmetician, astrologer^1.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.

गणच्छन्दस् n. a metre consisting of feet of 4
instants each.
गणदास m. N. of a dancing master.
गणान्न n. food from a corporation.
गणनाथ m. = गणेश.
गणनायक m. = गणेश.
गणप m. the same, protector or chief of a corporation.

गण॑प॑ति m. chief of a troop;
 the god Ganeśa.

गणपाठ m. collection of gaṇas;
 cf. गण॑ (g.).
गणवृत्त n. = गणच्छन्दस्.
गणश॑स् adv. by troops.
गणश्री॑ a. joined in troops.
गणाभ्यन्तर m. member of a corporation.
गणिका f. a harlot, courtesan.
गणिकादारिका f. daughter of a courtesan.*
गणिकान्न n. food from a courtesan.
गणिकाप्रवहन n. carriage of a courtesan.

गणिन् a. having adherents;
 surrounded by (—˚).

गणेश m. the god Ganeśa (lit. the lord of the hosts or
troops, cf. गण॑), also E. of Śiva.
गण्डपाली f. the region of the cheeks.
गण्डमाल (f.) swelling of the glands of the neck.
गण्डमा˚ला (f.) swelling of the glands of the neck.
गण्डमालिन् a. having swollen glands (cf. prec.).
गण्डलेखा f. the region (lit. line) of the cheeks.

गण्डस्थल n. ˚ली f. (adj. —˚ f. आ & ई) cheek
(lit. place or region of the cheeks).
गण्डु s. a pillow.

गण्डूष m. n. a mouthful of water or any other
[]
liquid (for rinsing the mouth or drinking);
 draught, gulp. —˚पेय a.
to be drunk by gulps, to be devoured (fig.).
गाण्डिव m. n. Arjuna's bow.
गाण्डीव m. n. Arjuna's bow.
